harvest.source: @yahoolovesyou mode=all pages=10 (mixed personal feed, not curator)

seeds.idea: US banks at 0% reserve requirements since March 2020 — what that does and does not mean
seeds.thesis: Zero required reserves changed the legal reserve ratio; it did not abolish credit constraints. The public debate confuses reserve requirements with capital, liquidity, and supervisory limits.
seeds.theory: Credit creation banking / endogenous money; distinguish reserve requirements from capital & LCR

seeds.idea: Stablecoins as transparent ledgers: privacy nightmare or compliance feature?
seeds.thesis: Retail stablecoin rails make transaction graphs more legible to counterparties and analysts than cash. Whether that is a bug or a feature depends on the institutional use case.
seeds.theory: Payment transparency vs financial privacy; surveillance capitalism meets rails

seeds.idea: PayPal stablecoin distribution across many countries — wallet power as market entry
seeds.thesis: Incumbent wallet distribution can move stablecoin access faster than crypto-native apps, but licensing and redemption design still decide whether the product is money or marketing.
seeds.theory: Two-sided platforms; distribution advantage vs regulatory perimeter

seeds.idea: HTTP 402 'Payment Required' as a native internet money primitive that never shipped
seeds.thesis: The web reserved a payment status code in 1991; three decades later payments still sit outside the protocol. That gap explains why wallets and processors intermediate every online transaction.
seeds.theory: Protocol design and path dependence in payment infrastructure

seeds.idea: SWIFT access as a foreign-policy instrument, not just a messaging utility
seeds.thesis: Threats to cut payment messaging access convert financial infrastructure into a geopolitical lever. Operators in small states must treat rail dependency as political risk.
seeds.theory: Weaponized interdependence (Farrell & Newman)
seeds.note: Seed tweet is partisan; ground in SWIFT/sanctions primary history, not the tweet's tone.

seeds.idea: MAS licensing as a trust bridge for regional fintech
seeds.thesis: Singapore licensing is often used as a credibility signal for regional expansion — but it is not a passport.

seeds.idea: Remittance cost compression and who captures the spread
seeds.thesis: Lower advertised FX fees hide spread and float; the real unit economics sit in corridor control.
seeds.theory: Two-sided platforms; payment corridor economics; information asymmetry on FX

seeds.idea: Retail CBDC vs wholesale settlement: different problems
seeds.thesis: Retail CBDC debates privacy; wholesale CBDC debates settlement finality among institutions.
seeds.theory: Public money hierarchy; payment system design; two-tier banking

seeds.idea: Reserve attestation quality as the real stablecoin product
seeds.thesis: The token is easy; the reserve, redemption, and attestation regime is the product.
seeds.theory: Bank-run theory applied to money-like liabilities; disclosure as product quality

seeds.idea: Open banking as forced data portability — who owns the customer?
seeds.thesis: APIs reallocate distribution power between banks and fintechs; customer ownership becomes a contract fight.
seeds.theory: Data portability; multi-sided platforms; regulatory forced interoperability

seeds.idea: When AI agents can pay: authorization design before autonomy
seeds.thesis: Agentic commerce fails first on authority and revocation, not model IQ.
seeds.theory: Principal–agent problem; payment authorization; least privilege

seeds.idea: Credit creation banking vs the fractional-reserve slogan
seeds.thesis: Public education still uses 20th-century metaphors for 21st-century bank funding.
seeds.theory: Endogenous money; credit creation; Basel capital/liquidity

seeds.idea: Idle crypto escheat / seizure rules on exchanges
seeds.thesis: State unclaimed-property regimes meet exchange custody — a boring legal risk with balance-sheet teeth.
seeds.theory: Property law; custody risk; institutional isomorphism

seeds.idea: Cashless mandates at physical points of sale
seeds.thesis: Forcing digital payment at tolls/gas stations is financial inclusion rhetoric with surveillance and outage risk.
seeds.theory: Payments as infrastructure; financial inclusion vs coercion; resilience

seeds.idea: Fintech unit economics under cheap capital
seeds.thesis: Many efficient rails only clear while customer acquisition and float are subsidized.
seeds.theory: Unit economics; predatory pricing vs learning; two-sided markets

seeds.idea: Bank-fintech partnership as distribution rent
seeds.thesis: Sponsor banks rent regulatory perimeter and trust; fintechs rent distribution and UX.
seeds.theory: Regulatory perimeter; two-sided platforms; rent vs ownership

seeds.idea: Embedded finance: who owns the customer complaint?
seeds.thesis: Embedded finance splits UX unity from legal duty; complaint routing is the real design problem.
seeds.theory: Principal–agent; regulatory perimeter; platform liability

seeds.idea: BNPL credit quality through the cycle
seeds.thesis: BNPL is consumer credit with checkout UX; cycle risk is the product risk.
seeds.theory: Consumer credit cycles; behavioral pricing

seeds.idea: Realtime payments and fraud acceleration
seeds.thesis: Realtime rails remove delay that used to function as a silent fraud brake.
seeds.theory: Payment finality vs dispute rights; authorized push payment fraud

seeds.idea: Merchant acquiring concentration risk
seeds.thesis: Acquirer/network concentration is a first-class operational risk for digital commerce.
seeds.theory: Payment networks; counterparty concentration

seeds.idea: On-chain FX vs traditional nostro networks
seeds.thesis: On-chain FX speed does not erase nostro, liquidity, and last-mile cash constraints.
seeds.theory: Correspondent banking; liquidity fragmentation; payment chains

seeds.idea: Tokenized deposits vs stablecoins (liability design)
seeds.thesis: Liability design — not chain choice — separates tokenized deposits from stablecoins.
seeds.theory: Money hierarchy; bank vs non-bank liabilities

seeds.idea: Travel rule / AML for VASPs as market structure
seeds.thesis: Travel Rule / AML for VASPs reallocates counterparty access and vendor power.
seeds.theory: AML as non-tariff barrier; network effects in compliance

seeds.idea: Card network messaging vs account-to-account rails
seeds.thesis: Rail choice is liability choice, not only fee choice.
seeds.theory: Payment system design; consumer protection

seeds.idea: Fintech failure resolution and ring-fencing
seeds.thesis: Without ring-fencing and resolution plans, fintech failure becomes a political event.
seeds.theory: Resolution regimes; bankruptcy remoteness; consumer protection

seeds.idea: Data localization vs regional payment platforms
seeds.thesis: Data localization forces multi-region payment architecture.
seeds.theory: Data sovereignty; platform architecture

seeds.idea: Insurance for smart-contract / oracle failure
seeds.thesis: Insurance for protocol failure needs explicit trigger design; most policies are imperfect maps.
seeds.theory: Insurance basis risk; operational risk

seeds.idea: Market structure after zero commissions (equities→crypto)
seeds.thesis: Zero-commission brokerage is a revenue-stack redesign with policy risk.
seeds.theory: Market microstructure; two-sided platforms

seeds.idea: Sovereign wealth as LP into fintech platforms
seeds.thesis: SWF capital is strategic capital with political externalities.
seeds.theory: State capitalism; political risk

seeds.idea: Climate risk disclosure in bank books (fintech angle)
seeds.thesis: Climate risk disclosure becomes a fintech data and credit-access constraint through banks.
seeds.theory: Climate finance; supervisory disclosure
